'As an additional cost to play this, BANISH a random card from your hand. / Blood Debt' -- Blood Debt is printed and fires from the card DB.

BANISH, NOT DISCARD. A discarded card goes to the graveyard and a banished one does not, so the two differ for every graveyard-recursion card and for anything counting a graveyard. Writing DISCARD_RANDOM here would put the card in the wrong zone while the ability still resolved.

A CARD-LEVEL `cost`, which play.py checks for legality and pays once. Never an ON_PLAY effect: a cost must BLOCK the play, and as an effect the card would be playable with an empty hand and simply pay nothing. No abilities at all -- an empty PLAY ability to hold the cost is a no-op the hygiene tests reject.
